notes.title: Valentine's Day Celebration Update
notes.content:
To sincerely repay your love.
Effects have been added to fill your eyes with hearts.
It is only playable during Valentine's Day every year (February 9th to February 14th).

+ Fixed an issue where some of New Year Mode's content (Yellow Topper Star) was still in the game.

Happy Valentine's Day!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41783941/d33a25d439e471a5e9de97031e043359c1a4b89a.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes For Dec 26
notes.content:
Added: New Year Mode only playable from December 26th to January 10th.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41783941/e7db82cae9cb232a6e8900bc59b97bc63ff9a8b9.gif[/img]

Happy new year!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Dec 24
notes.content:
The game description has been modified.

Added: 
A hat that only appears on Christmas day to keep the head warm.
Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Patch Notes For Jan 29
notes.content: Fixed an issue where, in certain cases, the second checkpoint would be unlocked even if the player did not reach it. Thank you for your feedback.
